en_before: Build around that tone. A metal or punk-rock tee can pair with combat boots, plaid skirts or ripped jeans, a studded belt and leather jacket. Dream-pop or shoegaze references can meet thigh-high socks, a mini skirt, platforms and hair clips for an e-girl or soft grunge interpretation. An emo or 2000s alternative tee with black skinny jeans, Converse or Vans and a light hoodie can evoke a darker Y2K direction. These are outfit suggestions rather than fixed genre uniforms.
